definitions.explanation: The quantity of particles—most commonly pollen—dispersed into the air over a given area and time. Frequently reported in weather forecasts during {花粉症|かふんしょう} (hay fever) season.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{飛散量|ひさんりょう}は{多|おお}い。
スギ{花粉|かふん}の{飛散量|ひさんりょう}が{予測|よそく}されている。
examples.english: The amount of cedar pollen dispersal is being forecast.

examples.japanese: {気温|きおん}が{上|あ}がると{花粉|かふん}の{飛散量|ひさんりょう}も{増|ふ}える{傾向|けいこう}がある。
examples.english: When temperatures rise, the amount of pollen dispersal tends to increase as well.

notes:
Compound of {飛散|ひさん} (scattering, dispersal) + {量|りょう} (amount, quantity). In everyday usage almost always refers to pollen, but can apply to any airborne particle (dust, ash, radioactive material).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花粉|かふん}の{飛散量|ひさんりょう}: amount of pollen dispersal
- {飛散量|ひさんりょう}が{多|おお}い／{少|すく}ない: dispersal is high / low
- {飛散量|ひさんりょう}{予測|よそく}: dispersal forecast
- {飛散量|ひさんりょう}がピークに{達|たっ}する: dispersal reaches its peak

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {花粉|かふん}{情報|じょうほう}: pollen information — the broader category that includes the count
- {花粉症|かふんしょう}: hay fever — the condition affected by {飛散量|ひさんりょう}
